svg.text: The BEV contains agents — no lanes, no road, no corridor
obstacle.offline is TEN DYNAMIC AGENT CLASSES: automobile · heavy_truck · bus · other_vehicle · trailer · person · rider · stroller · animal · protruding_object.
PhysicalAI-AV ships no map data, so the dashed band is a HAND-DEFINED ±1.5 m assumption about the ego lane — not a perceived corridor.
The decode is NOT blank — it is confidently WRONG about where things are.
Every window here HAS a lead vehicle in the corridor (dashed blue rule). The decoded panels put 35–68 cells above τ = 0.7 — comparable to the ground truth's 31–33 —
yet essentially none of them land in the ego band. That is what IoU ≈ 0.02 beside a retention ratio of 0.932 means in practice: the relative structure survives prediction,
the absolute placement does not. Across 129 labelled windows the corridor is empty in the decode for 81.4 % (encoded) and 92.3 % (predicted) of them.
τ = 0.7 is INHERITED from the P8 gate and never re-tuned here. Panels show cells ≥ τ, not the full-resolution probability field.
